productFindings.description: The pipeline acceptance CLI resolved the repository root one directory too high, so real route records could not be loaded.
productFindings.fix: Resolve three parent directories from scripts/stack127/tool-pipeline and protect the path with a source-level regression test.

environmentAndHarnessFailures: The in-app Browser had no available browser instance, so the approved repository Playwright fallback was used.
Sandbox DNS blocked the first managed-development connection; the guarded command passed with the required network permission.
A 20-second first-navigation limit was shorter than a cold Next.js compilation; the harness now allows 90 seconds.
The first readiness check treated two absent readiness attributes as hydrated; it now requires an explicit ready flag or a React-owned interactive element.
The planner harness initially required an exact accessible name and rejected the correct required-field suffix; DOM evidence showed the custom row existed, and only the locator was corrected.
The first planner 320 px probe reset state before light-theme screenshots; the probe now runs after all four result screenshots, and result persistence is asserted.
One read-only development database receipt attempt timed out; the immediate retry passed without a write.
